body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2010') -- <Visual News> Sony unveiled its Full HD 3D TV 'LX900' series, integrated Motionflow Pro 240Hz technology for smooth motion at CES 2010 in Las Vegas from Jan. 7-10. It is also featuring edge LED backlighting with monolithic design and equipped with Wi-Fi capability.
< AVING Las Vegas team is on-site bringing readers the latest product CES2010 from the show floor, covering the press conferences >
